notes:
Say what your video is, and Crisp still understands you.

'trim the wedding footage to 10s', 'slow the wedding footage down', 'speed the footage up' and 'loop the footage' all used to answer 'I didn't catch an edit in that' — while the same sentences with a shorter object ('trim the footage to 10s', 'loop the video', 'speed it up') worked fine. Four different rules were each sized to one example sentence rather than to the words people actually use for their own footage. One of them literally counted characters, so 'wedding footage' failed where 'drone footage' worked.
